Name: Boa Hancock - Penny Replacer HD
Author: Jolamods
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Boa Hancock - Penny Replacer HD[/b][/size][/center]

Replaces [b]Penny's appearance[/b] with Boa Hancock. HD portraits with multiple expressions; normal and winter sprites; two-piece beach and bathhouse outfits; dance, wedding and action poses.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54221/54221-1792523216-2110977472.png[/img][/center]
[b]REQUIREMENTS & INSTALLATION[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6 on PC and SMAPI 4.1.10+.
1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.9.0+ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]Scale Up Unofficial[/url] 2.7.0+.
2. Close the game and extract the complete [b][CP] Nico Robin for Penny HD[/b] folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
3. Disable other portrait/sprite replacers for Penny, then launch through SMAPI.
Updating: replace the previous folder without leaving duplicates. Uninstall: remove this mod folder.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54221/54221-1792523216-2110977472.png[/img][/center]
[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Visual replacement only: Penny keeps the original name, dialogue, schedule, relationships and events. Frameworks are separate downloads. Other NPC replacers can coexist when they target different characters. The internal mod ID and folder name retain the old Nico Robin working name so existing installations can update safely. The character shown is Boa Hancock.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54221/54221-1792523216-2110977472.png[/img][/center]
